chunks.title: K nearest neighbor
chunks.text: There's another approach. It's a data centric approach or instance based approach where we keep the data and we use it when we make a query. So here's an example. Let's suppose our barometric pressure has gone down by five millimeters.

chunks.title: K nearest neighbor
chunks.text: And we want to consult our model to see how much it's going to rain today. So our query here is at negative five millimeters. And let's suppose that k is equal to three. So we will find the three nearest historical data points to this query. And those are one, two, three.

chunks.title: K nearest neighbor
chunks.text: And we'll use them to estimate how much it's going to rain today.
